missing_information_behavior: Review all dietary iodine sources, thyroid history, medication and existing products before considering supplementation.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer iodine deficiency from dietary pattern alone.
Do not use kelp/seaweed supplements with variable iodine content as a default source.
Do not recommend iodine in thyroid disease without clinician review.
professional_escalation_conditions: Thyroid disease, pregnancy/lactation, amiodarone or lithium use, thyroid surgery or nodules.
population_and_context: People reporting little iodized salt and few animal-source foods; iodine intake depends on local food fortification, seaweed and other dietary sources.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Compare total intake with life-stage reference values and local iodization policy; account for seaweed variability.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Iodine fact sheet describes food sources and risks of both deficiency and excess; regional iodization context matters. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
